title: How Hackers Weaponized DEV.to's Mention System to Spread a Phishing Scam
why_read: A more detailed technical breakdown of the same Dev.to phishing campaign, explaining exactly how the mention system was abused to deliver scam emails.
analysis: This post dissects how attackers exploited Dev.to's @mention notification system to make a phishing campaign look like official platform communication, since mentioning many users triggers automated emails from the platform's own legitimate infrastructure. It explains the use of lookalike Unicode characters to impersonate an official support account and the use of URL shorteners to obscure the malicious destination. This is a reasonably useful case study in how legitimate platform features can be weaponized for phishing, which is a recurring and instructive pattern in web security.
